verdict.rationale: Docs show Financial Connections lets you request specific data types (balances, ownership, transactions) rather than a single blanket account link, and different use-case flows (ACH, Connect payouts, personal finance apps) pull only the subset of data relevant to that use case, implying product-scoped consent. However, there's no explicit documentation of a formal 'permissions' parameter/API, no description of the actual consent screen showing scoped checkboxes, and no independent/community evidence confirming data-minimization behavior in practice. Missing for 10: explicit permissions/scopes API reference, documented consent UI mechanics, and independent verification that only requested scopes are granted.
